content: I'll start by reading the test image and the part index simultaneously.

This BSR reference (PlantWild_27) shows white curd with discrete brown mushy spots - somewhat similar to the test image. I must now view at least one reference from each of the remaining classes (Black_Rot and Downy_Mildew).
Black_Rot shows leaf vein patterns - clearly a leaf disease, not matching the whole plant/head view in the test image. Now viewing Downy_Mildew.

I've now covered all 4 classes. The leaf-based diseases (Black_Rot, Downy_Mildew) don't match. The test image is a whole plant with head discoloration. Using remaining views to narrow between BSR and Alternaria.
BSR PlantWild_34 matches well — mostly white curd with discrete brown sunken spot in a field setting, very similar to test image. Let me view one more Alternaria reference to confirm.
Alternaria leaf shows classic target/bull's-eye lesions - clearly different from the test image. Using my final view to check another Downy Mildew reference to rule it out completely.

Downy Mildew shows angular yellow leaf lesions - clearly a leaf disease, not a head disease. This rules it out completely.
